description:
Workana is the largest remote work platform for talents in Latin America. Our new segment, Workana Premium , focuses on matching the most exceptional professionals with leading and innovative companies around the globe. Enjoy competitive compensation, dedicated support, and the flexibility of remote work within a dynamic environment that fosters collaboration and professional advancement.

We are proud to present you with the following opportunity.

About Our Client

Our client is a family-owned legal services business undergoing a major transformation to scale their operations through advanced AI and software solutions. They are building the future of their industry by automating workflows, enhancing efficiency, and creating AI-powered products that redefine how legal services are delivered.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to join the team and lead the development of cutting-edge agentic orchestration systems. This role will focus on two key initiatives:

  1. SaaS Conversion – Transforming the company’s existing AI-driven report generation framework into a scalable SaaS product.
  2. Deposition Agent System – Building and orchestrating a new AI agent workflow to automate deposition preparation, integrating diverse data sources and leveraging Model Context Protocol (MCP).

The ideal candidate is an experienced AI engineer with strong integration skills, Python expertise, and hands-on knowledge of agentic orchestration and MCP. You will collaborate directly with the CTO, execute autonomously, and potentially mentor junior engineers as the team expands.

Responsibilities
  • Design and implement agentic orchestration workflows, including Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication and self-reinforcement learning.
  • Lead the SaaS conversion of the company’s existing AI-based product, ensuring scalability, security, and reliability.
  • Build the Deposition Agent System , integrating APIs and data pipelines (email, CRM, file systems) into LLM-powered agents.
  • Work with Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect and contextualize data across multiple systems.
  • Evaluate and integrate AI frameworks (e.g., N8N, CrewAI, or alternatives) to optimize agent performance.

title: Gedragswetenschapper Pleegzorg
description:
Overzicht

Analytisch, inspirerend, daadkrachtig " Jor" jetz

Pleegzorg vraagt om meer dan alleen goede bedoelingen. Pleegouders hebben intensieve begeleiding nodig om een veilige en stabiele omgeving voor kinderen te bieden, vaak in complexe situaties. Hulpverleners spelen daarin een sleutelrol, en als gedragswetenschapper coach jij hen om dit goed te kunnen doen. Je sluit aan bij hun vragen, denkt mee over casuïstiek rondom opvoeding, hechting en trauma, en vertaalt wetenschappelijke inzichten naar de praktijk van pleegzorg. Met jouw kennis en ervaring train je hulpverleners zodat zij pleegouders en kinderen optimaal kunnen begeleiden.

Daarnaast volg je de ontwikkelingen in de samenleving en in de jeugdzorg en werk je mee aan de doorontwikkeling van pleegzorgconcepten. Samen met de teammanager bewaak je de kwaliteit van zorg én zorg je dat ons pleegzorgaanbod zichtbaar is bij gemeenten en samenwerkingspartners. Dat vraagt om analytisch inzicht, inspirerend leiderschap en onderzoekende nieuwsgierigheid. En in acute situaties wanneer er bijvoorbeeld sprake is van crisissituaties bij pleeggezinnen of plaatsingen treed je daadkrachtig en met helderheid op.

Jouw werk doet ertoe!

Als gedragswetenschapper ben je er vooral voor de zorgprofessionals. Samen met de pleezorgbegeleiders zet je begeleidings- en behandeltrajecten op en houd je deze op de rit. Binnen Timon Amsterdam maak je deel uit van het team van Gedragswetenschappers en landelijk neem je deel aan de beleidsdagen/vergaderingen van het zorgconcept Pleegzorg. De protocollen en richtlijnen maken we op maat voor de specifieke situatie van cliënten. Het mooie is dat je ook invloed hebt op de kwaliteit van zorg in het algemeen. Jouw werk doet ertoe! Wil je meer zien over het werk van onze Gedragswetenschappers, bekijk dan hier het filmpje van Helga, een van onze Gedragswetenschappers binnen Timon.

Dit ga je doen
  • Je stuurt met de teammanager het team duaal aan.
  • Je werkt samen met ketenpartners rondom een cliënt, zoals bv CJG en Jeugdbescherming.
  • Je maakt kwartaalrapportages en analyseert de uitkomsten inhoudelijk.
  • Je bent betrokken bij het nemen van kernbeslissingen.
  • Je biedt nabijheid en coaching on the job aan het team.

“Als gedragswetenschapper ben je betrokken bij het beleid en bij de uitvoering daarvan door begeleiders. Dat maakt dit werk veelzijdig en waardevol”

Susanne Kooij, gedragswetenschapper jeugdzorg

Dit vragen we van je

Deze functie noemen we in ons functiehuis: gedragswetenschapper. Je bent analytisch sterk, sociaal en slagvaardig. Daarnaast kun je goed werken op individuele basis. Verder beschik je over:

  • Een universitair masterdiploma richting gedragswetenschappen en/of psychologie en/of pedagogische wetenschappen;
  • Kennis van gedragsproblematiek en -stoornissen en ervaring met erkende therapeutische (crisis)interventies en behandelmethoden;
  • Kennis van gezinsproblematiek, systemische interventies en van de ontwikkeling van kind tot puber;
  • Ervaring met het coachen van teams;
  • Kennis van de wet- en regelgeving;
  • SKJ registratie;
  • Ervaring binnen de pleegzorg is een pré.
Dit bieden wij

Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op:

  • Bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao jeugdzorg (schaal 11) van € 3.972,06 tot € 6.002,30, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;
  • Jaarcontract. Bevalt het wederzijds? Dan zetten we dit om in een vast dienstverband.
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding;
  • Eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris;
  • Trainingen en opleiding gericht op jouw functie.
Wij zijn Timon

Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Met ruim 800 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra.

Jij @ Timon?

Denk jij dat Timon de organisatie is die bij jou past? Solliciteer dan op de vacature voor gedragswetenschapper Pleegzorg. Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over de functie? Neem dan contact op met Suzanne Kooij-Groeneveld (gedragswetenschapper), tel. of Bouke Hartman (regiomanager), tel. . Voor vragen over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met onze recruiter Kitty Bernardus, tel. .

description:

Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. Position Overview

We are seeking a highly creative and hands‑on Senior Talent Development Partner to support the establishment of our newly formed Talent Development function. In this role, you will embrace a customer‑centric, pragmatic approach, laser‑focused on delivering maximum impact through the simplest, highest‑quality solutions.

We are here for the growth and development of our customers, Turing Team Members. You will partner closely with leaders to understand their desired development outcomes, time constraints, and needs. Leveraging this knowledge, you will craft relevant, engaging learning content that drives measurable business results for our internal customers. You will seek out simple yet impactful solutions, recognizing that the most compelling learning experiences are often the most practical.

Responsibilities

Deeply collaborate with Turing leaders to translate team development needs into compelling, practical learning experiences driving measurable growth.

Design and develop engaging, multimedia‑rich asynchronous learning content using tools like Articulate, tailoring for diverse styles through simple, high‑impact solutions.

Serve as the go‑to operational owner for the LMS system, curating and maintaining a dynamic, streamlined training catalog. Continuously refine materials for relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with customer needs.

Embody an agile, customer‑obsessed mindset, rapidly producing high‑quality, iterative content elevated by feedback and data.

Be a key driving force behind the development, engagement, and iterations of Sales and Engineering bootcamp programs.

Qualifications

3–5 years of experience driving the development of L&D initiatives in a high‑growth startup or late‑stage tech environment.

Experienced leveraging LMS systems like Docebo, e‑learning platforms, intranet solutions, and instructional design tools like Articulate to deliver impactful learning experiences.

Exceptional collaboration and interpersonal skills, with a strong customer‑centric approach to building relationships and delivering outstanding service to stakeholders.

Proven ability to analyse training metrics, evaluate impact, and translate findings into actionable recommendations to enhance learning solutions.

Demonstrated skill in translating business objectives into innovative, engaging, and practical learning solutions that drive measurable results.

Values

We are client first: We put our clients at the centre of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.

We work at Start‑Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favour action because momentum is the foundation of perfection.

We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing

Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)

Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)

Competitive compensation

Flexible working hours

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

O QUE PROCURAMOS

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.

DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES
  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos.
  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas.
  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.
  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
  • Manter-se bem‑informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.
REQUISITOS
  • Formação Acadêmica :
    • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
    • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA
  • Certificações :
    • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM)
    • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia
    • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil)
  • Experiência :
    • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde
  • Conhecimentos Específicos para a função : Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos.
  • Competências Comportamentais : Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.
  • Outros Requisitos Importantes : Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho : REMOTO

MODEL DE CONTRATAÇÃO

Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.

REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS

A negociar durante processo seletivo.

title: BALCONISTA DE ACOUGUE
description:
Responsabilidades

Atender ao cliente de acordo com o padrão de qualidade Bistek. Entregar o produto ao cliente, conforme especificado por ele, visando sua satisfação. Abastecer as mercadorias do setor de açougue, de acordo com o layout padrão, a fim de não deixar rupturas na área de venda, e manter o mix adequado de produtos. Precificar os produtos, imprimindo as etiquetas de preço no mata-burro, verificando a cor da etiqueta: vermelha = oferta; amarela = normal. Cartalizar os itens promocionais, imprimindo as raquetes no mata-burro, e colando‑as acima da etiqueta de preço vermelha, atrás do porta‑preço. Realizar a alteração de preços, verificando a listagem impressa, e trocando as etiquetas nas seções. Fazer o rodízio dos produtos, com a finalidade de manter aqueles com validades próximas na frente, e os mais recentes atrás, ou ao fundo da prateleira. Conferir as mercadorias enviadas pela Central de Distribuição, verificando as notas para identificar possíveis divergências, e analisando a qualidade dos produtos. Examinar as condições dos produtos expostos na área de venda, encaminhando para o setor de quebra aqueles considerados inadequados para a venda. Conferir a organização e temperatura das câmaras e balcões conforme planilha. Executar o descarregamento das carnes, seguindo as orientações do líder neste processo, armazenando os produtos nas câmaras frias. Auxiliar na produção e manipulação dos produtos de açougue (fatiar ou moer). Manipulação de miúdos, bifes, linguiça e carnes fracionadas. Manuseio das máquinas para realizar corte nas carnes. Recolher a devolução de mercadorias deixadas na frente de caixa, colocando de volta na seção ou encaminhando para a quebra dependendo do estado de conservação. Manter a organização e limpeza do setor como um todo (área de produção, depósito, área de venda, câmaras frias), conforme cronograma definido pelo líder. Retirar o lixo de setor, armazenando‑o em local adequado. Executar outras atividades correlatas às acima descritas, a critério do superior imediato.

Localização

São José, Santa Catarina

Job description

O que somos:

A Galapagos Capital é umacompanhia de investimentos global, com soluções financeiras interconectadas para você, sua família e seu negócio.

Investment Banking, onde criamos soluções de crédito e M&A de forma flexível, simples e eficiente, adaptadas às necessidades de nossos clientes. É fácil fazer negócio com a gente!

Asset Management, onde nosso time de analistas seniores realiza análises contínuas e minuciosas do mercado adaptadas ao cenário econômico global, que norteiam as estratégias de investimentos para soluções financeiras mais assertivas aos portfólios dos nossos clientes. Aliando performance com resiliência!

Wealth Management , onde promovemos o acesso mais transparente e eficiente ao mercado de capitais, aprimorando a forma de fazer banking, através da criação de produtos exclusivos e da expertise de profissionais com mais de 30 anos de mercado em gestão de patrimônio e riscos. Evoluímos o seu jeito de investir!

Nossa missão

Acreditamos nopoder transformadordo mercado financeiro que une, de forma eficiente, quem precisa de crédito e quem tem capital para investir. Num mercado bastante concentrado e dominado por grandes bancos, como o brasileiro, o potencial para essa transformação é imenso. A Galapagos Capital quer liderar esse processo. Adotamos um jeito disruptivo de fazer banking: sem agências e sem a utilização de balanço.

Por serinovadora, leve e criativa , a Galapagos reúne a capacidade de originar, estruturar e alocar operações de crédito de maneira que nossos clientes possam usufruir desses rendimentos de forma rentável e com pouca volatilidade. Desse jeito, ajudamos empresas e pessoas a terem acesso a crédito de forma competitiva e transformamos esses créditos em soluções de investimento -tudo dentro de casa.

A evolução na forma de fazer Banking - Somos mais eficientes, mais ágeis e, principalmente, oferecemos resultados muito melhores para nossos clientes. É para isso que a Galapagos nasceu: para ajudar o mercado financeiro a evoluir, alcançando seu potencial e beneficiando milhões de brasileiros.

Saiba mais sobre a Galapagos:

Main responsibilities

Resumo do Cargo:

Estamos em busca de um Líder de Gestão de Processos experiente e dinâmico para avaliar criticamente os processos corporativos, identificar gargalos, ineficiências e oportunidades de otimização. O foco será mapear, diagnosticar e implementar melhorias em fluxos de trabalho, garantindo excelência operacional e alinhamento estratégico.

No seu dia a dia:

  • Liderar mapeamento, análise e redesenho de processos utilizando metodologias consagradas (Lean Six Sigma, BPMN 2.0), com foco em eficiência, redução de desperdícios e transformação organizacional;
  • Gerenciar portfólios de projetos, priorizando iniciativas estratégicas, definindo e monitorando KPIs;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares e áreas de negócios para planejar, executar e integrar soluções inovadoras, aplicando boas práticas de gestão (PMI, ITIL) e metodologias ágeis (SAFe, Scrum, Kanban);
  • Elaborar relatórios, dashboards e insights estratégicos (em Power BI, Tableau, Azure DevOps ou similares) para públicos variados, da operação à Diretoria Executiva, com clareza, precisão e impacto;
  • Impulsionar automação de processos (RPA, workflows digitais) e integração de sistemas corporativos (ERP, CRM).
Requirements and skills

O que esperamos de você:

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Engenharia, TI, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência comprovada em avaliação, mapeamento e redesenho de processos corporativos;
  • Experiência consolidada em projetos de ciclo de desenvolvimento de sistemas, com domínio de metodologias ágeis (SAFe, Scrum, Kanban) e tradicionais (PMI);
  • Atuação prévia no setor financeiro, preferencialmente com produtos bancários (crédito, investimentos, meios de pagamento);
  • Domínio de ferramentas:
  • Mapeamento: BPMN 2.0;
  • Análise de dados: Excel avançado, Power BI ou Tableau;
  • Gestão de projetos: Azure DevOps, MS Project, Jira ou Trello.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações: PMP, CBPP, Scrum Master, Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt ou superior), Black Elect;
  • Conhecimentos técnicos: SQL, VBA, Python, RPA, ERP (SAP, Totvs, Oracle);
  • Pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.
Additional information

Benefícios

  • Salário Fixo;
  • PLR Própria;
  • Vale Alimentação e Vale Refeição;
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Vale Transporte.

Diariamente, você deverá monitorar as atividades dos projetos em andamento, identificando e mitigando riscos, além de manter uma comunicação fluída entre todas as equipes envolvidas.

  • Desenvolvimento do plano do projeto : desde o entendimento e definição do escopo / briefing, passando pela estimativa de esforço e elaboração de cronogramas;

  • Garantir a execução das atividades de acordo com prazos e tempo estimado, com a qualidade exigida, e seguindo os protocolos de trabalho do Studio no Brasil e EUA;

Elaboração de relatórios de andamento do projeto, e demais relatórios necessários para acompanhamento dos principais indicadores de sucesso das áreas de atuação.

  • Inglês fluente (escrito e falado), pois trabalhará diretamente com times globais;

  • Proficiência em metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos (Agile, Scrum etc.);

description:
Growth Marketer – Part‑Time, Global Running Company

Hi… My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients.

Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B.

I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

  • Newsletter and email flows – build, optimise, and automate campaigns, analyse data, and test iteratively.
  • Digital advertising – plan and run campaigns on Meta and Google, explore new platforms, measure ROI, and scale what works.
  • Case studies, sponsorship, and bold idea pitching – create compelling content and develop partnerships to reach new runners, companies, and destinations.
  • Collaboration and execution – work directly with me, aim for fast results, and drive continuous improvement.

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture, and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world. We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry.

You’ll be working remotely, with only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you – running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast‑moving, and positive company should.

  • USD 1,400 a month
  • 25 hrs a week
  • Contract via Upwork

We want you to bring a fast‑mover attitude, a strong collaborator mindset, a drive to grow, and, above all, execution skill. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you).

Estamos procurando um City Manager altamente dinâmico e prático para COLOCAR A REGIÃO DESEJADA , que seja apaixonado por mobilidade e esteja disposto a crescer conosco. Esta é uma oportunidade única para participar da expansão de nossas operações em Campinas e causar um impacto significativo no futuro da mobilidade urbana.

Sobre a Kovi

Na Kovi, acreditamos que mobilidade muda direções. Nascemos em 2018 com um propósito claro: criar oportunidades para que todos possam dirigir suas vidas. Hoje, somos referência em oferecer soluções inovadoras para clientes, promovendo inclusão financeira e autonomia para quem movimenta as cidades.

Nossa cultura é viva, diversa e colaborativa. Valorizamos pessoas curiosas, que aprendem rápido, pensam diferente e constroem junto. Na Kovi, você tem liberdade para ser quem é, e espaço para crescer como nunca imaginou.

Diversidade importa. Inclusão também. Por isso, estamos comprometidos em construir um ambiente seguro, respeitoso e acolhedor para todas as pessoas.

QUE TAL TRABALHAR EM UMA EMPRESA A SERVIÇO DAS CIDADES INTELIGENTES DO AMANHÃ?

A INDIGO é líder mundial em gestão de estacionamentos e mobilidade individual. Estamos em mais de 500 cidades de 10 países. No Brasil, são mais de 370 operações em 97 cidades de 24 estados + DF.

Sabe como a gente faz tudo isso acontecer?

Ao redor do mundo, contamos com mais de 9 mil colaboradores – dos quais 4.700 são brasileiros. Todos eles atuam no gerenciamento de soluções personalizadas e cada vez mais inteligentes, que viabilizam uma jornada tranquila e integrada para o cliente.

Uma das prioridades da INDIGO é ouvir seus funcionários e garantir que eles tenham carreiras bem-sucedidas. Por isso, investimos em treinamentos e na criação de políticas de desenvolvimento. Além disso, nos esforçamos para fomentar a igualdade de gênero, promover oportunidades iguais e combater a discriminação. Nosso objetivo é criar um ambiente de trabalho onde todos se sintam realizados, motivados e engajados.

Mais propósito, menos impacto, mais Indigo

Estamos transformando nossos estacionamentos em hubs de serviço úteis e sustentáveis que formam elos cruciais na corrente de mobilidade urbana. Sem estacionamento, não há mobilidade, e, sem mobilidade, não há desenvolvimento. Porém, esse desenvolvimento precisa estar de acordo com o desejo das pessoas: menos estresse, ruídos, poluição e trânsito.

Por isso,“criar espaços para uma cidade tranquila em movimento” é o que fazemos na Indigo. Esse é o nosso propósito. É para isso que trabalhamos diariamente.

description:
Growth Marketer (Global Running Company – Part‑Time) – Room to Grow into Head of Marketing

Hi…
My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. I wanted to give you a genuine feel for what it’s like to be a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours – the good, the bad, and the ugly.

Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be analytical and structured, while also being creative enough to craft great copy, spot new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B.

I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. When our marketing DNA clicks with our passion for running, the results can feel like cartwheels.

Key Responsibilities
  • Build and optimize our email marketing strategy: design flows, create smart automations, and deeply analyze data to improve performance.
  • Plan and run digital advertising campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms and monitoring which tactics move the needle.
  • Research new tech, trends, and channels, and test initiatives in one city before scaling across destinations.
  • Create compelling case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help reach new runners, companies, and destinations.
  • Own launch and growth of newsletters, ensuring they meet performance metrics.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the world, filling gaps you spot and backing your initiatives.
What You’ll Experience

Remote work with only 2–3 hours of internal meetings per week. All other time is reserved for deep work and getting things done. You’ll have frequent calls and continuous Slack communication; no one will be left alone.

We’re a small, global team that values progress, focus, and a fast‑moving mentality. I may be impatient and dislike sloppiness, but I’m also kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding. If you’re eager to excel, we’ll become great teammates. Execution is the most important skill of all – if we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle.

Seniority Level

Entry level

Employment Type

Part‑time

Job Function

Marketing and Sales

Industry

Travel Arrangements

Compensation & Hours

USD 1,400 per month
25 hours per week
Managed via Upwork

Benefits & Notes

The salary is comfortable for reduced working hours, not a Ferrari level pay. Running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast‑moving, positive company should be your primary motivation. We usually take down our job posts within 3–4 days due to many applicants. Please write to me with a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for this role and why you’d like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI, we want to know the real you).

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Hi, my name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with words like driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one!

Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground.

You’ll be working on a newsletter and pling!

  • An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors.

Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously.

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more…

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode: growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business; growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations; growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends.

You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don’t throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works.

You will also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that “makes sense” to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive.

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you – running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast‑moving, and positive company should.

The Contract Details Are As Follows

  • USD 1,400 a month
  • 25 hrs a week
  • Managed via Upwork

Oh, and hey… if you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don’t believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn’t align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.

title: Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description:
The Role We Need:

PadSplit is looking for a React Native Mobile Engineer to lead the development of our mobile applications and strengthen the core experience for members and hosts. This role is essential as we expand our mobile capabilities, enhance reliability, and improve the end-to-end experience across both iOS and Android. You’ll also contribute to web development using React.js and collaborate with backend engineers working in Django/Python.

The Person We Are Looking For:

We’re looking for a proactive, adaptable engineer who thrives in a dynamic, highly collaborative startup environment. You’re someone who can move seamlessly between mobile and web development, make thoughtful technical decisions, and take ownership of delivering high-quality, user-focused features. You’re comfortable working autonomously, partnering cross-functionally, and wearing multiple hats when the situation calls for it.

Here’s What You’ll Do Day-To-Day:
  • Build Mobile Apps: Develop, maintain, and optimize React Native apps for both iOS and Android.
  • Enhance Web Frontend: Build and refine responsive, user-friendly web interfaces using React.js when needed.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with design, product, and backend teams to translate ideas into working features.
  • Elevate Code Quality: Lead and participate in code reviews to uphold best practices and maintainability.
  • Optimize Performance: Diagnose and resolve performance issues across mobile and web platforms.
  • Ensure Reliability: Implement and maintain automated testing for React Native and React.js components.
  • Drive Development: Participate in standups, sprint planning, and architectural discussions that shape team priorities.
  • Adapt to Needs: Contribute to web development during periods when web priorities temporarily exceed mobile demands.
Here’s What You’ll Need To Be Successful:
  • React Native Expertise: Proven experience building, optimizing, and shipping production mobile apps across iOS and Android.
  • Strong React.js Skills: Deep understanding of modern frontend development, state management, and UI performance.
  • Backend Awareness: Familiarity with Django/Python environments and experience interacting with APIs.
  • Database Knowledge: Experience working with PostgreSQL or MySQL databases.
  • Version Control Mastery: Comfort with Git/GitHub/GitLab and collaborative development workflows.

title: Hr Director
description:
At Medtronic you can begin a life-long career of exploration and innovation, while helping champion healthcare access and equity for all. You’ll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation in a more connected, compassionate world.

A Day in the Life

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

  • Designs, implements and executes human resources strategies for business unit and functional groups.
  • Partners with business operations to ensure a complete understanding of business needs and objective and proactively resolves HR and business issues.
  • Provides solutions through organizational effectiveness and employee life cycle management.
  • Anticipates and plans for long-term human resource needs and trends in partnership with business management.
  • Responsible for and/or serves as a HR liaison in key projects.
People Management Functional Career Stream

Management and supervisory professionals with one or more employees who are focused on tactical, operational and some strategic activities within a specified area. Levels within the management career stream typically have six or more direct reports. The majority of time is spent overseeing their area of responsibility, managing performance, developing talent, engagement and inclusion, communicating business and operational developments, planning, prioritizing and / or directing the responsibilities of direct reports. Goal achievement is typically accomplished through performance of direct and / or indirect reports. A key responsibility of roles in this career stream is managing people. which includes: accountability for mentoring, developing and coaching staff on meeting/exceeding performance expectations and defined objectives, providing leadership to staff ensuring the prioritization of strategic and department level initiatives to include defining performance goals and targets, conducting performance reviews, and staff 1:1s to guide performance management and employee development efforts and manage toward departmental goals.

Differentiating Factors Autonomy

Manages department (s) or small unit that includes multiple teams led by managers and / or supervisors.
Provides motivational leadership for the area managed.
Provides thought and technical leadership.
Performs work without appreciable direction.

Organizational Impact

Leads the development of the strategy for own department or business area, ensuring links to the company’s aims and objectives.
Management authority to make large business decisions and some strategic decisions.
Decisions impact the financial performance, employees, or public image of the operational unit and/or company.
Typically has budget or P&L accountability for a department, broad functional area or geography.

Innovation and Complexity

Drives innovation across the business area, encouraging best practice and knowledge sharing.
Significantly improves, changes or adapts own department or business area’s processes, systems, products or services.
Problems and issues faced are complex, difficult and undefined, and require detailed information gathering, analysis and investigation to understand the problem.

Communication and Influence

Develops long term strategic relationships and alliances with key internal and external stakeholders.
Communicates and conducts briefings with senior or executive leadership regarding ongoing operations and strategic initiatives.
Influences across functions and businesses to negotiate and gain cooperation on operational issues and internal divergent objectives.

Leadership and Talent Management

Directs and leads a department, broad functional area or geography, including one or more teams led by managers and / or supervisors.
Determines supervisory relationships, and creates workforce and staffing plans to accomplish business results.
Authorizes hiring, firing, promotion and reward within own area.

Required Knowledge and Experience

Requires broad management and leadership knowledge to lead multiple job areas, and detailed functional and operational expertise.
Typically has mastery level knowledge and skills within a specific technical or professional discipline with broad understanding of other areas within the job function.
Requires a Baccalaureate degree (or for degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree which satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)( 4)(iii)(A) and minimum of 10 years of relevant experience with 7+ years of managerial experience, or advanced degree with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience with 7+ years of managerial experience.

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

Benefits & Compensation

Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package
A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

This position is eligible for a short-term incentive called the Medtronic Incentive Plan (MIP). This position is eligible for an annual long-term incentive plan.

About Medtronic

We lead global healthcare technology and boldly attack the most challenging health problems facing humanity by searching out and finding solutions.
Our Mission — to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life — unites a global team of 95,000+ passionate people.
We are engineers at heart— putting ambitious ideas to work to generate real solutions for real people. From the R&D lab, to the factory floor, to the conference room, every one of us experiments, creates, builds, improves and solves. We have the talent, diverse perspectives, and guts to engineer the extraordinary.

title: Regulatory Affairs and Licensing Lead - Brazil
description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Tether and its affiliated entities (e.g. Bitfinex) are searching for an organized self‑starter to join our Regulatory and Licensing team. The successful candidate is someone with a deep understanding of legal and regulatory requirements pertaining to the crypto-asset industry in Brazil, and who is excited by the opportunity to apply their existing regulatory experience in an exciting and dynamic business environment.

The successful candidate will report directly to the Head of Regulatory Affairs & Licensing – Latin America, serving as the primary point of contact for regulatory and licensing matters within Brazil. This is a senior position designed for professionals with proven experience engaging with or working within financial regulators, supervisory authorities, or policy‑making bodies. The ideal candidate combines strategic insight with hands‑on execution, demonstrates a diplomatic, solutions‑oriented approach in navigating complex regulatory environments, and is able to anticipate regulatory changes and adapt strategies proactively to evolving market and legal environments. You will represent the company in regulatory discussions, contribute to regional initiatives under the guidance of the Head of Regulatory Affairs & Licensing – Latin America, and ensure local implementation aligns with the company’s broader Latin American regulatory objectives.

To succeed in this role, the incumbent will continuously strive to self‑develop and enhance their skill sets including understanding the Company’s products and services, blockchain technology, crypto‑assets and the regulatory requirements. Engage with industry associations, chambers, and other stakeholder groups to promote innovation and collaboration.

You will have a focus around translating regulatory requirements in Brazil into clear and actionable strategic recommendations, managing relationships and communications between various stakeholders both internal and external to the business.

Responsibilities

  • Regulatory Strategy Development: development and execution of regulatory strategies, identifying preferable market/s in the region from which to operate. Ensure local implementation aligns with Tether’s broader Latin American regulatory objectives.

  • Regulatory Advocacy and Collaboration: participating in regulatory agency interactions, engaging with relevant regulatory authorities, industry bodies, and policymakers to shape the regulatory landscape for stablecoin issuers, advocating for policies that promote innovation while ensuring safety and compliance. Actively contribute to public consultations, working groups, and industry forums, maintaining a high standard of professionalism and institutional diplomacy.

  • Policy Analysis and Guidance: Provide analysis on local regulatory proposals, and advise the business on potential regulatory risks and opportunities, while driving initiatives to influence regulatory frameworks as well as monitoring for change across regulations to ensure proactive compliance. Produce concise internal policy briefs and recommendations to inform senior management decision‑making.

  • Regulatory approval process: contribute to the process of obtaining necessary license approvals in identified markets, where appropriate. Support the preparation and coordination of documentation and responses to regulatory inquiries, ensuring strategic consistency and accuracy.

  • Cross‑functional Leadership: Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., expansion, legal, compliance, finance) to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and to proactively address emerging regulatory challenges. Serve as the local regulatory lead, ensuring effective communication and alignment with regional priorities.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years regulatory experience within the financial services or crypto‑asset industry.

  • Preferred: Minimum of 5–8 years regulatory experience within financial services, fintech, or crypto‑asset industries.

  • Ability to apply knowledge of key regulatory frameworks in Brazil both strategically and operationally and provide direction to resolve complex regulatory issues.

  • Demonstrated diplomatic skills and ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships.

  • Expertise in preparing regulatory analysis including the preparation and execution of interactions with regulatory authorities, such as regulatory consultation response submissions.

  • Proven experience working with or within regulatory authorities (e.g., central banks, financial supervisory agencies, or ministries of finance) is strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to draft or contribute to public policy responses, regulatory filings, or industry position papers.

  • Communication: Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.

  • Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Must have hands‑on professional capable of working collaboratively and independently, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Fluency in English and native proficiency in the local language of Brazil.

  • University degree.

  • Advanced degree in Law, Economics, Political Science, or a related field preferred.

Important Information for Candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third‑party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double‑check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io.
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Global Head of Cloud Alliances
description:
Join to apply for the Global Head of Cloud Alliances role at Canonical

6 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Global Head of Cloud Alliances role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Head of Cloud Alliances to lead business development and partnerships with the global public clouds. As the publisher of Ubuntu, Canonical is already a trusted partner with the leading guest OS and select services for the major hyperscalers. We have a large portfolio of open source software on the cloud marketplace for enterprise customers, and are looking to expand our global cloud partnerships.

Reporting to the VP of Global Alliances, the Global Head of Cloud Alliances will lead teams that bring innovation to the public cloud platforms, joint go-to-market with public cloud sales communities and marketplaces, and our global customer and partner contracts. They will work closely with cloud partners, from engineering to product management and marketing, to deliver open source solutions at scale for their cloud customers.

Our Cloud Alliance team builds trusted relationships with partners at all levels, from joint technical work to executive strategy. Their goal is to increase Canonical market share in the cloud ISV ecosystem, develop cloud channel sales, evangelize the partnership and lead all business interactions. The Global Head of Cloud Alliances will own the strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with all cloud partners, as well as promotion of our cloud related activities - from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and cloud related events.

Our company is largely distributed, this role can be based anywhere in the Americas or EMEA.

The role entails

  • Taking ownership of Canonical's global cloud partner strategy, leading efforts to forecast, driving bookings, and growing revenue worldwide
  • Building strong, cross-functional relationships across teams to ensure a unified approach to technology and market execution
  • Inspiring and guiding teams to achieve accelerated revenue growth with Cloud partners, continually refining and evolving strategies for success
  • Establishing and nurturing executive-level relationships with key partners, laying the foundation for long-term success and mutual growth
  • Steering our offering from concept to execution, aligning product management and marketing strategies while scaling success through our global sales organization

What we are looking for in you:

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Exceptional leadership and presentation skills, capable of energizing teams and stakeholders while delivering compelling data-driven narratives
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • An in-depth understanding of open source technologies, Ubuntu, and the competitive ecosystem, with an eye for identifying opportunities that others might miss.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, and proactive—take ownership, and deliver exceptional results

Nice to have

  • A track record in alliance and indirect sales management, with an ability to build partnerships that drive success
  • Solid experience in the Public Cloud sector, coupled with an understanding of the evolving landscape of technology and innovation.
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

  • Experience deploying models in production environments
  • Familiarity with event-driven platforms and message queues (e.g., Kafka, Redis Streams)
  • Comfort working with streaming or time-series data

  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud deployment

  • Infrastructure: Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, Docker

title: Principal Architect
description:
A Biz está em busca de um Staff ou Principal com perfil hands-on para atuar na modernização de plataformas críticas no setor fintech. Procuramos alguém com sólida experiência em arquitetura de sistemas, conhecimento avançado em Microsoft Azure, foco em APIs, e que seja entusiasta de Inteligência Artificial aplicada ao contexto de negócios e engenharia.

Aqui na Biz você vai:

  • Liderar iniciativas de modernização de sistemas legados, desenhando e implementando arquiteturas escaláveis, seguras e orientadas a serviços;
  • Atuar na definição e evolução de arquiteturas baseadas em APIs RESTful, mensageria e microsserviços;
  • Projetar soluções cloud-native utilizando recursos do ecossistema Azure (App Services, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Functions, etc.);
  • Participar ativamente do desenvolvimento de soluções, revisando código, implementando POCs e garantindo aderência às melhores práticas;
  • Explorar oportunidades de uso de Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning para ganho de eficiência, automação e geração de valor para o negócio;
  • Promover a adoção de práticas modernas de engenharia como CI/CD, infraestrutura como código, observabilidade e segurança;
  • Interagir com stakeholders de produto, engenharia e negócios para alinhar a visão técnica com os objetivos estratégicos;
  • Apoiar na formação técnica do time, promovendo cultura de excelência e aprendizado contínuo.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com modernização de sistemas legados em ambientes regulados ou críticos (ex: bancos, meios de pagamento, fintechs);
  • Forte domínio em Azure e suas principais ofertas voltadas para aplicações distribuídas;
  • Proficiência em design e implementação de APIs, microsserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos;
  • Experiência prática com linguagens como Go, C# ou Python, e frameworks modernos de desenvolvimento;
  • Conhecimentos em DevOps, pipelines de CI/CD, containers e IaC (ex: Bicep, Terraform ou ARM Templates);
  • Vivência com projetos envolvendo IA ou ML, mesmo que em estágio inicial ou experimental;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times multidisciplinares;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança da informação aplicadas à nuvem e APIs.


Será Considerado um Diferencial:

  • Certificações Azure (ex: Azure Solutions Architect Expert);
  • Experiência sistemas de cartões e integração com sistemas bancários;
  • Contribuições em comunidades técnicas ou projetos open source.

O que oferecemos:

Cuidamos de você:

  • Plano de saúde Sulamerica para o titular e você ainda pode incluir dependentes pagando apenas a coparticipação;
  • Plano Odontológico para você e dependentes;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale-Refeição de R$ 1.016,66 e alimentação de R$ 798,06, para todo mundo se alimentar bem!
  • dress-code flexível;
  • Auxílio Creche para dependentes de até 6 anos e 11 meses. Na Biz, acreditamos que o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores e suas famílias é fundamental, por isso, acreditamos que este benefício apoiará pais e mães em suas jornadas;
  • Regime de Trabalho: Modelo híbrido, com presença periódica em nosso escritório.
  • Bônus anual baseado em metas corporativas.

Pensando no seu bem-estar físico e emocional:

  • Totalpass para colaboradores e dependentes. O Total pass é uma plataforma corporativa de atividade física, com foco na qualidade de vida e bem-estar, que permite acesso à academias, estúdios parceiros, programa e nutrição, terapias e muito mais para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental;
  • Temos uma parceria com a Posher, uma startup que oferece serviços de bem-estar como, ginástica laboral, yoga, mindfulness, psicoterapia em grupo, dicas de viagem, entre outros;
  • Convênio com o SESC.

Para o seu desenvolvimento:

  • A Biz possui uma verba totalmente direcionada para cursos e treinamentos dos colaboradores;
  • Universidade Biz: Uma plataforma de cursos e treinamentos pensada especialmente para o colaborador da Biz.

A Biz nasceu com um único propósito: Simplificar. Com tecnologia de ponta e focados na experiência, sem renunciar a segurança, reimaginamos o mundo de pagamentos para torná-lo simples e ao mesmo tempo completo.

Projetos de expansão ousados e metas desafiadoras fazem parte do dia-a-dia da Havan. A loja iniciou suas atividades em 1986 no município de Brusque (SC), com apenas um funcionário, hoje são mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por todo o país.

Desde o início o proprietário Luciano Hang mostrou uma visão à frente. title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
About the job Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

Aqui na Shô, acreditamos que cada membro de nossa equipe é fundamental para o nosso sucesso, e que diversidade de perspectivas e vivências são essenciais para movimentar nosso negócio e impulsionar o nosso propósito de mudar o mundo para melhor. Fazer parte do nosso time é a oportunidade de se desenvolver dentro de uma cultura de muita agilidade. Se você ama assumir grandes responsabilidades e fazer o que nunca foi feito, a Shô é seu lugar. Aqui você terá grandes desafios, trabalhará em colaboração com um time diverso e contribuíra para o futuro do e-commerce no Brasil, criando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

Modelo de Trabalho

Adotamos um modelo de trabalho híbrido, esse modelo permite que as pessoas ajustem seu ambiente de trabalho de acordo com suas necessidades pessoais, ao mesmo tempo em que promove a colaboração e interação no escritório.

Job Description Qual será a sua missão

Como Analista Sênior de Campanhas e Merchandising na vertical de Auto & Moto, sua missão será transformar estratégia em execução. Você terá o papel de orquestrar campanhas promocionais de ponta a ponta, conectando diferentes áreas para garantir que ofertas cheguem ao cliente de forma atrativa, competitiva e alinhada ao calendário estratégico da Shô. Além disso, será protagonista na análise de dados, definição de estratégias de descontos e vouchers, e na busca por melhorias contínuas que fortaleçam a categoria e impulsionem o crescimento do nosso negócio.

Como será o seu dia a dia
  • Acompanhar o calendário de marketing e coordenar campanhas junto às áreas envolvidas.
  • Discutir briefings, garantir a operacionalização e entrega de ofertas pelo time comercial.
  • Definir produtos, categorias e lojas a serem promovidos em cada ação.
  • Estruturar e executar a estratégia de vouchers da categoria.
  • Estabelecer relacionamentos com áreas parceiras para otimizar padrões operacionais.
  • Monitorar métricas diárias alinhadas ao calendário promocional e sazonalidade.
  • Analisar dados para apoiar decisões relacionadas a preços e uso de descontos.
  • Preparar e participar de reuniões periódicas, fornecendo análises e recomendações.
  • Criar materiais de apresentação de iniciativas e resultados para a liderança.
  • Desenvolver relatórios, ferramentas e planilhas de acompanhamento para áreas de cliente e comercial.
  • Propor e implementar melhorias nos processos e rotinas da área.
Requisitos
  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Marketing, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em campanhas comerciais, merchandising, marketing ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Forte habilidade analítica e experiência com métricas de negócio.
  • Excel avançado; SQL será considerado diferencial.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de articulação com diferentes áreas internas.
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e orientado a resultados.
  • Vivência em e-commerce e conhecimento da categoria Auto & Moto será considerado um diferencial.
Benefícios

Somos o vizinho especialista em produtos frescos e naturais, com qualidade impecável e uma experiência que faz o cliente se sentir em casa. Nossa alma é de feirante: gostamos de conversar, sorrir e oferecer aquele conforto emocional das feiras livres da infância, com um atendimento próximo, humano e cheio de alegria. MANIPULADOR DE ALIMENTOS Escala: 6x1 Tipo de contrato: CLT ATIVIDADES DO CARGO: • Preparar alimentos para venda e produção (saladas, antepastos, sucos, frutas, legumes, verduras, temperos, dentre outros), seguindo as fichas técnicas e programação de produção preestabelecidas, pesando, envasando, embalando e etiquetando, para atendimento da demanda • Abastecer a área de vendas, observando as datas de vencimento e correta exposição dos produtos, garantindo a promoção e venda • Organizar os produtos estocados, observando as validades e locais apropriados de armazenamento, para garantir a conservação e qualidade do produto • Seguir as normas estabelecidas pela Vigilância Sanitária e Manual de Boas Práticas REQUISITOS: • Ensino fundamental completo INCLUSÃO E DIVERSIDADE Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência. Valorizamos a diversidade e estamos de braços abertos para todos os talentos, independentemente de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero ou orientação sexual.#LI-Onsite### Requirements##### StudiesElementary School (1st grade)### BenefitsAlimentação no LocalCesta básicaWellHUBPlano de SaúdePlano OdontoConvênio Farmácia### About Hortifruti Natural da TerraSomos o Grupo Hortifruti Natural da Terra, a maior rede varejista de hortifrutigranjeiros do Brasil. Atuamos em um segmento com um jeito diferente de oferecer o frescor das feiras com a praticidade dos grandes mercados. Nosso compromisso é levar sempre até a mesa dos nossos clientes o que a natureza tem de melhor, com frutas, legumes e verduras e, assim, ajudá-los a ter uma vida mais saudável. Somos uma empresa nacional de grande porte, com uma equipe de mais de 5 mil colaboradores e 76 lojas espalhadas por 4 estados (RJ, SP, ES e MG). Nossas lojas recebem cerca de meio milhão de clientes todos os meses. Com operações no modelo omnichannel, as compras podem ser realizadas também pelo site, app, WhatsApp e marketplaces parceiros, atendendo consumidores nas regiões onde estão presentes em até três horas. Transportamos 60 mil toneladas de produtos todos os meses, do campo às bancas em até 24 horas. O Hortifruti Natural da Terra é referência em frutas, legumes, verduras e outros alimentos frescos. Unimos a relação de confiança e proximidade com os produtores ao bom atendimento e produtos de qualidade. Não somos um supermercado, nem feira. Mas o melhor dos dois! Nossa Missão: Promover uma vida mais natural, nos tornando referência e o principal destino de produtos frescos do Brasil. Nossos Valores são: • Jogo aberto e íntegro • Foco em resultado com qualidade • Trabalho em equipe compartilhando o sucesso • Excelência no Atendimento • Jeito simples e alegre de ser • Atitude Responsável Atuamos com profissionalismo, amor e um sorriso estampado no rosto, esse é nosso jeito de ser. Somos mais do que um time, somos uma família! Queremos promover a diversidade em todos os sentidos e todas as equipes. Por isso, queremos o seu olhar também para torná-lo cada vez mais seguro, acolhedor, criativo e inclusivo. Todas as nossas vagas também são abertas para pessoas com deficiência, e toda a diversidade em relação a raças, cores, religiões, gêneros e orientações sexuais é importante e será muito bem-vinda. \_\_

Projetos de expansão ousados e metas desafiadoras fazem parte do dia-a-dia da Havan. A loja iniciou suas atividades em 1986 no município de Brusque (SC), com apenas um funcionário, hoje são mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por todo o país.

Desde o início o proprietário Luciano Hang mostrou uma visão à frente. A loja que vendia apenas tecidos, abriu suas portas para a importação, mudou de segmento para loja de departamentos, expandiu o número de filiais, sendo que hoje são mais de cem lojas e não pára mais de crescer. É essa inovação, persistência e comprometimento que sustentam o grande sucesso e fenômeno de vendas da Havan.

Além disso, foram valores como humildade, alegria e simplicidade, pregados pela empresa, que conquistaram tantas pessoas. Por ano a Havan recebe mais de 110 milhões de clientes, que tem à disposição um mix de mais de 100 mil produtos nacionais e importados. Essa liberdade de compras é representada pelo símbolo da marca: a Estátua da Liberdade, muito apreciada por todos. As lojas ainda contam com praça de alimentação, estacionamento gratuito e muito mais. Todo esse conjunto torna a Havan um centro de turismo, lazer e compras, e a loja de departamentos mais completa do Brasil.
